title: [GMCP 203.011.04] Adversarial and failure behavior: Complete prompt and completion server surface
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-011-04. Close validation, authorization, isolation, privacy, bounded-resource, cancellation, concurrency, crash, retry, rollback, and recovery behavior. Add deterministic negative, attack, race, corruption, and fault-injection fixtures derived from the vector threat model. Vector outcome: Prompt discovery/get and argument completion implement all current schemas, roles, embedded content, pagination/filtering, list changes, cache semantics, validation, cancellation, authorization, and deterministic ranking. Prompt templates are immutable per advertised version, untrusted substitutions remain data, and injection, oversized expansion, missing argument, localization, and concurrent-update cases are proven. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
